summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new features: Portal User Management (edit/delete/password reset), Printable Service Report (signature sections, warranty info, satisfaction survey), and Quote Template (payment terms, VAT calculation). All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Portal User CRUD endpoints properly implemented with authentication
POST /api/portal-users/{id}/reset-password validates minimum password length (6 chars)
DELETE /api/portal-users/{id} returns proper 404 for non-existent users
Service Report endpoint returns comprehensive ticket data including customer, asset, work orders, and summary
Quote Create page has all required fields: customer select, payment terms (peşin/vadeli/taksit), VAT rates (0%, 1%, 10%, 20%)
All UI components have proper Turkish localization
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up multiple TEST_ prefixed portal users during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features are working correctly. Backend tests cover: Portal User CRUD (list, create, update, delete), Portal User password reset with validation, Portal User toggle active status, Service Report endpoint, Quote data endpoints (customers, parts, system-settings). Frontend tests verified: Portal Users page with edit/delete/password reset buttons and dialogs, Service Report page with signature sections (Teknisyen/Müşteri), warranty info, satisfaction survey, print button, Quote Create page with customer select, payment terms dropdown, VAT calculation, item add/remove functionality.
